summary: No current-holding fundamental score changes. The important tactical moves are MISC breaking below first support to RM7.77, TTWO breaking old $216-217 support to ~$214.13 but remaining above the ~$210 reassessment line, TSLA rallying to ~$376 after the Cybercab launch and reclaiming the $375 area, and YTLPOWR recovering to RM5.75 above the old RM5.65-5.70 band. XOM fell back below its $164-166 reclaim zone despite record diesel stress. HIBISCS remains above RM2.20 confirmation and DAYANG reclaimed RM1.45 without repairing weak operating evidence. The macro backdrop improved tactically for precious metals/risk assets after Waller, but August ISM Services shows strong orders/activity plus Prices 72.6 and Employment 47.8, so the overall regime remains stagflationary rather than cleanly risk-on.
